FOrcaSlicer 2.3.2-fos.8.6.1

A patch release. Everything in 8.6.0 applies unchanged; nothing was added.

Fixed: the 0.18 Standard preset for the U1 0.6 mm nozzle printed at a 0.25 mm layer height, 39% thicker than its name. Inherited from upstream.

Fixed: the installer shipped 27 profile files that had been deleted from the project - 19 process presets ending in ' copy.json' or '_old.json', and 7 filament profiles under old names. They showed up as duplicate entries on fresh installs as well as upgrades.

Both are corrected automatically on first launch, and the manual cleanup step in the 8.6.0 notes is no longer needed.

If you saved your own preset derived from the 0.18 one and it carries its own layer height, that value stays as you set it - open it once and check.
